name: gcwork
description: Connects the local Codex and Claude Code to WorkBuddy via a thin expert + MCP engine. Natural-language dispatch, uniform routing, artifact verification, and half-automatic resume — survives the 9-minute host timeout by running detached.

displayDescription.en: Plug your Codex and Claude into WorkBuddy — talk naturally, the engine routes, verifies, and resumes across a detached process.
displayDescription.zh: 将 Codex 与 Claude 接入 WorkBuddy，自然语言派单；引擎统一路由、验收、续跑，detached 进程抗宿主超时。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 先帮我看看现在能不能用：Codex 和 Claude 都装好、登上了吗？各自有哪些模型和思考强度可选，你那套预设规则是怎么配的？
defaultInitPrompt.en: First, check whether things actually work: are Codex and Claude installed and logged in? What models and reasoning levels does each have, and how are the preset rules set up?

quickPrompts.zh: 先帮我看看现在能不能用：Codex 和 Claude 都装好、登上了吗？各自有哪些模型和思考强度可选，你那套预设规则是怎么配的？
quickPrompts.en: First, check whether things actually work: are Codex and Claude installed and logged in? What models and reasoning levels does each have, and how are the preset rules set up?

quickPrompts.zh: 用 sol、思考强度 high，把项目里那几个还没处理的 TODO 清掉，改完跑一遍测试再告诉我。
quickPrompts.en: Use sol at high reasoning effort: clear the remaining TODOs in the project, run the tests, and tell me how it went.

quickPrompts.zh: 我打算把构建从 webpack 换到 vite，你先评估方案、再拆任务清单。这两件事分头派给合适的人做，最后给我一份能直接开工的迁移计划。
quickPrompts.en: I'm thinking about moving the build from webpack to vite. Evaluate the options first, then break it into a task list. Hand the two pieces to whoever fits best, and give me a migration plan I can start on right away.
